austronesian-expansion.summary: From Taiwan, seafarers carrying outrigger canoes, pigs and taro spread across half the globe — reaching Madagascar in the west and Easter Island in the east, the widest distribution of any language family before European expansion.

egypt-old-kingdom.summary: The pyramid age, when a centralised Egyptian state organised labour on a scale not seen before.

great-pyramid.summary: Tomb of Khufu and the only surviving wonder of the ancient world; the tallest human-made structure for nearly four thousand years.
